description: Upload local files into a file input element (<input type='file'>) or an upload trigger button/menuitem using Chrome DevTools Protocol DOM.setFileInputFiles. Supports inline post-upload waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText.

files.description: Array of absolute local file paths to upload

selector.description: CSS selector or @ref of the <input type='file'> element or upload trigger button/menuitem

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after uploading

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after uploading

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after uploading

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after uploading
